title: 11. Projects: All Remaining AI Agent Patterns
summary: Projects for All Remaining AI Agent Patterns.
objectives: Build the All Remaining AI Agent Patterns projects end to end
Keep a short README with assumptions and tradeoffs

sections.title: Project Structure
sections.body:
```
tool_use_agent/
│
├── .env
├── tool_definitions.py   ← OpenAI-format tool schemas
├── tool_executor.py      ← Actual Python tool functions
├── agent.py              ← Tool Use Agent core loop
└── main.py               ← Entry point
```

sections.title: Project Structure
sections.body:
```
plan_execute_agent/
│
├── .env
├── tools.py          ← Tool functions + registry
├── planner.py        ← Planner LLM (generates steps)
├── executor.py       ← Executes each step
├── synthesizer.py    ← Combines results → final answer
├── agent.py          ← Master controller
└── main.py           ← Entry point
```

sections.title: Project Structure
sections.body:
```
multi_agent/
│
├── .env
├── tools.py                ← Shared tool functions
├── agents/
│   ├── __init__.py
│   ├── base_agent.py       ← Base class for all agents
│   ├── research_agent.py   ← Specialist: Research
│   ├── coder_agent.py      ← Specialist: Code
│   ├── math_agent.py       ← Specialist: Math
│   ├── weather_agent.py    ← Specialist: Weather
│   └── writer_agent.py     ← Specialist: Writing
├── orchestrator.py         ← Master Orchestrator
└── main.py                 ← Entry point
```

sections.title: Project Structure
sections.body:
```
rag_agent/
│
├── .env
├── documents.py         ← Sample knowledge base documents
├── embeddings.py        ← Azure OpenAI embedding functions
├── vector_store.py      ← In-memory vector store (cosine similarity)
├── indexer.py           ← Chunks + indexes documents
├── retriever.py         ← Retrieves top-K relevant chunks
├── agent.py             ← RAG Agent (retrieve + generate)
└── main.py              ← Entry point
```

sections.title: Project Structure
sections.body:
```
tree_of_thoughts/
│
├── .env
├── models.py         ← Data models (ThoughtNode, Tree)
├── thinker.py        ← Generates child thoughts (Expand)
├── evaluator.py      ← Scores each thought (Evaluate)
├── searcher.py       ← Beam search (Prune + Select)
├── solver.py         ← Generates final answer from best path
├── agent.py          ← ToT Agent controller
└── main.py           ← Entry point
```

sections.title: Project Structure
sections.body:
```
lats_agent/
│
├── .env
├── tools.py              ← Tool functions + registry
├── models.py             ← Trajectory, Node data models
```
